notes: GAAP city, FY ended 2022-09-30. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); roll-forward 38,584,752 + 37,374,991 - 31,904,719 + 2,152,871 - 3,738,378 = 42,469,517. Ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 29,929,604 (p4); certificates of deposit 6,339,522 as ending_investments; county treasurer cash 346,537 (p4) is a separate line not added (as FY2023). Business-type = enterprise funds Total column (Landfill, Electric, Combined System Utilities) of the proprietary statement (p7); internal service funds (Health Insurance, IT; pp6-7, combining pp21-22) excluded as in later years. Contributions in aid of construction 317,829 in business_type.other_financing; loss on disposal of capital assets (24,015) is printed in the nonoperating revenues (expenses) section and the SoA counts it in general revenues, so it is kept as a negative receipt line (category Loss on Disposal of Assets, as FY2023; the question is open with the user). Business roll: 246,363,921 + 93,407,018 - 89,586,899 + 317,829 = 250,501,869. Landfill 'Other revenue' 19,044, participation and capacity agreements and net coal sales are counted in charges for services on the Statement of Activities (p2). Proprietary cash flows from the enterprise Total column (pp8-9). Grants lines have no grantor printed (category other, detail Grants) except the ARPA Fund (federal by fund name). Detail: budget schedules for General, Street, Museum and Debt Service funds (pp12-16, budgetary basis) and the nonmajor combining statement per fund column (pp17-20; Police Equipment Sinking and Natural Disaster funds print no activity; Total column not used). Capital outlay labelled with a function only where the fund name names one; others 'Capital Outlay'. Component unit skipped. Read pages 1-22 of 22
